sections.title: Page 3

summary.text: An introduction stating that this is the style guide for the regional office's publications and information products, to be used as a design and layout reference by all designers, with a contact address for further information.

sections.extract: 1 This is the style guide for WPRO publications and information products. All designers working on WHO WPRO publication and information products should use this as reference for design and layout. Templates and further guidelines are also available. For more information on WPRO publications guidelines, please contact wpropuballstaff@who.int INTRODUCTION

sections.extract: 3 WPRO LOGO

sections.title: Page 6

summary.text: Explains that the regional office logo may be used only on materials it endorses and must not be altered, rotated, recreated or obstructed. Lists three versions of the logo (blue, black, and white on a dark background) with their colour codes.

sections.extract: 4 The WHO WPRO logo The logo for the World Health Organization Regional Office for the Western Pacific (WPRO) should only be used on materials endorsed by WPRO. It should be presented as per guidelines here. This is essential to maintain a consistent presentation of our identity. Do not alter, rotate or modify the logo. It should never be recreated. Do not obstruct the logo. Three versions: The three versions of the

sections.title: Page 7

summary.text: Gives size and spacing rules for the logo, including an exclusion zone of at least 1 cm around it and a minimum logo size of 3 cm.

sections.extract: 5 Size and spacing Leave “exclusion zones” around the logos (at least 1cm width distance) around the logos to ensure they maintain visual impact. Also the minimum logo size is 3cm (the smallest size at which the logo is still legible in print and on screen) For other sizes, no less than 1/4 width of logo. summary.text: Explains that clear space around the logo should be equal on all sides in all sizes and co-branded uses, shows two co-branding options, and repeats that the logo must not be altered or recreated and only official files used.

sections.extract: 6 Clear space should be equal on all sides. This ratio of space should be applied to the logo in all sizes and for all co-branded applications. sections.title: Page 9

summary.text: Lists logo misuse examples, such as adding text or elements, separating the emblem from its text, or placing it on complex backgrounds, and says only white, regional blue or solid black should be used, with the WHO logo favoured beside partners' logos.

sections.extract: 7 Geneva Example 1 Example 3 Example 4 Example 2 • Do not add text or element • Do not separate emblem from text • Do not mix the logo with a complex background • Only white, WPRO blue or solid black should be used • Note the position and colour when set alongside partners’ logos should favour the WHO logo.

sections.title: Page 10

summary.text: Notes that official logos exist in different languages and for different country and regional offices, supplied in JPEG, EPS and BMP formats, and repeats the rules against altering, recreating or obstructing the logo.

sections.extract: 8 WHO WPRO official logos in different languages WHO WPRO official logos for different country and regional offices within the Western Pacific region. All WHO logos are provided in different formats: JPEG, EPS, BMP; other formats can be supplied on request. Do not alter, rotate or modify the logo. It should never be recreated. sections.title: Page 23

summary.text: Explains pagination and the suggested order of elements, with preliminary pages in lower-case Roman numerals (title page, copyright, contents, foreword, acknowledgments, contributors, abbreviations, executive summary) and main pages in Arabic numerals (chapters, references, annexes), then inside and back covers.

sections.extract: 21 PAGINATION Preliminary pages have lower-case Roman page numbers • Title page • Copyright + disclaimer + cataloging (behind title page) • Table of contents (list of chapters, figures and tables) • Foreword or Preface • Acknowledgments • List of contributors • List of abbreviations • Executive summary Main pages have Arabic page numbers • Chapters • References or bibliography • Annexes Inside back cover and back

sections.title: Page 26

summary.text: Advises using images from the regional office or WHO photo library, gives formats for photo credits on the copyright page, and sets quality requirements of high resolution, preferring TIFF, EPS or JPG over GIF and PNG, with alternative text for web files.

sections.extract: 24 Photos and credits It is best to use WHO images from the Regional Office or WHO photo library (wpromedialib@who.int). Photo credits should be added at the copyright page, in this format: Photo credits: WHO/Name of photographer Photo credits: ©Nameofphotographer ©WHO ©WHO Quality: Images in high resolution.
